<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `os serve (command, 33 pages)`, `/api/v1/data (route, 40 pages)`
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **29** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 11fea6b000894eb6c4cf6d79f28fe3109cca46bb` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `789330410aa4c163d19862dbf89d97d83444b44b` — the merge of head `cccb00ea51453ea8cc05e2d98bf457ec39cd466b` into base `11fea6b000894eb6c4cf6d79f28fe3109cca46bb`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 789330410aa4c163d19862dbf89d97d83444b44b && git checkout 789330410aa4c163d19862dbf89d97d83444b44b
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 11fea6b000894eb6c4cf6d79f28fe3109cca46bb cccb00ea51453ea8cc05e2d98bf457ec39cd466b && git checkout -B drift-repro 11fea6b000894eb6c4cf6d79f28fe3109cca46bb && git merge --no-ff cccb00ea51453ea8cc05e2d98bf457ec39cd466b

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 11fea6b000894eb6c4cf6d79f28fe3109cca46bb
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 11fea6b000894eb6c4cf6d79f28fe3109cca46bb` → pass the list as

## ✅ ACCEPT: PR #23947 at `cccb00ea51` (#23743, `Fixes #23743`). It queues on a true-green head

`domain:cli` seat 1 (#6024) · `marchtian` · session `session_01PFB9ZGRWYvjhTXsd8i6KBp` · 2026-10-16T13:53Z · holder of claim `6213641477`. Report: `os-dev-report` `6216644056`.

## 席位核对

1. **Shape, read on GitHub:** draft against `main`, head `cccb00ea51`. Line 1 `Fixes #23743`, the only closing keyword. Line 2 `Clause-②: no`, line-initial and bare, as the claim declares. Assignee `marchtian`. 6 files: `serve.ts`, `format.ts` (docblock only), `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` (the two IPC rows), two new test files, one changeset. `check-governed-merges --pr 23947`: NOT governed (0 of 6 paths). The non-merge commits carry the model-free trailer pair.
2. **The change, read against the diff:** at the publish site `publishBoundPort(...)` runs only when `httpServer === 'composed'`, the same `resolveHttpServerComposition` value the banner's address rows already read; otherwise only the banner prints. One predicate decides the banner rows, `objectstack:listening` and the runtime state file. `objectstack:seed-settled` is still sent on a no-transport boot and is its only message, which keeps `SeedSettledMessage`'s no-hang rule. The `MCP:` row now needs `mcpRouteMounted` (a composed transport and `kernel.hasPlugin(MCP_ROUTE_OWNER_PLUGIN)`, the dispatcher that mounts `/api/v1/mcp`). `publishBoundPort`, its channels and their order, `resolveBoundPort` and `printServerReady` are unchanged. No new package-entry export; no `packages/spec` edit.
3. **Docs:** `cli.mdx:269`-`:270` now say that a boot binding no HTTP server sends no `objectstack:listening` and that `seed-settled` is then its only message. Both match the code. Nothing under `content/docs/releases/`.
4. **Pins and measurement:** both halves reproduced at the public door on base `7a6ba03109` before any edit (a `listening` message and state file naming a port answering `ECONNREFUSED`; an `MCP:` row for a route answering 404). The integration file boots `bin/run.js` three times with an `ipc` channel: production `--no-server` (messages exactly `['objectstack:seed-settled']`, no state file ever created), the default-boot CONTROL (`[listening, seed-settled]`, the message equal to the `API:` row, health 200), and a config-mounted Hono under `--no-server` (no `MCP:` row, `/mcp` 404). Ablations through `ablation-replace.mjs` with a trap restore and a rebuilt CLI: the publish gate (3 soft legs and both wiring pins red, controls green) and the MCP gate (the Hono case and its source pin red); both restored to the HEAD blob. They ran on blob `8de5619d0a58`, before the docblock-only `cccb00ea51`.
5. **CI at `cccb00ea51`:** 41 check-runs, 36 `success`, 5 `skipped` (each on the `EXPECTED_SKIPS` roster); the five required are `success`, the six `Test Core` shards and `Build Docs` included. `mergeable_state` clean; `git merge-tree` against current `origin/main` is clean.
6. **The changeset** (`@objectstack/cli` `patch`): what an operator now sees on `--no-server` (no `listening` message, no state file, no `MCP:` row for an unmounted route) and what is unchanged (`seed-settled`) match the diff.
7. **Out of scope:** `out_of_scope_findings[0]` is carried to #23744, which asks exactly that question (the production `--no-server --preset minimal` process exits 0 by itself after its banner). The seat posts the measurement there at this PR's landing, since two of the channels it names change here. `[1]` (a stale state file no longer overwritten, the `start.ts` comment, a non-default dispatcher prefix): **Acceptance notes**, no class, carrier none.

**Landing:** this seat flips ready and arms auto-merge through the relay.
